title: Property Industry Excellence Awards 2025: Entries Open Now
text:
DUBLIN, 2025-06-19 01:30:00
Two new award categories, set to debut in 2025, are injecting fresh excitement into the Property Industry Excellence Awards. These additions will recognise outstanding achievements within the Irish property sector.
Shining a Light on Excellence The awards are expanding to celebrate the industry’s leaders and commercial triumphs.
The new “Lifetime Property Excellence” award will honor an individual’s lasting impact. A “Commercial Transaction of the Year” award will spotlight impactful deals. entries are now open to businesses in the property and construction sectors. What’s new for the Property Industry Excellence Awards? Two new categories are being introduced: “lifetime Property Excellence” and “Commercial Transaction of the Year,” which will be featured in the 2025 awards program .
Did you know? -The Property Industry Excellence Awards are a key event for networking and recognizing innovation in Ireland’s property sector. The awards ceremony typically draws hundreds of professionals.
Jim Clery, head of real estate at KPMG , at last year’s awards ceremony
the “Lifetime Property Excellence” award will celebrate an individual’s leadership.The commercial deal prize will recognize a notable transaction showing scale and innovation.
Reader question: -Beyond recognition, what tangible benefits do award winners typically experience in terms of business growth or industry influence? Share your thoughts. more Categories and Opportunities The 2025 awards also include other categories, providing a broad scope for recognition. Construction projects completed between January 1, 2024, and August 31, 2025, are eligible for the Construction Project Award.
Additionally, the Developer Award acknowledges firms impacting Ireland’s built environment. The Rising Star Award identifies up-and-coming professionals with under a decade of experience. The Housing Award recognizes projects meeting Ireland’s housing needs with sustainable solutions.
Furthermore, the Small Agency of the Year Award is open to agencies with 10 or fewer employees. Other categories include the Architecture Award, Placemaking and Planning Award, the PropTech Award, and the Fund Manager Award.
The Power of Recognition: Beyond the Trophy Winning a Property Industry Excellence Award isn’t just about a night of celebration in Dublin. Award recipients often experiance a notable boost in brand recognition and a strengthened position within the irish property market. This enhanced visibility can open doors too new business opportunities and solidify their industry standing.
Let’s explore how the awards translate into tangible benefits for winners:
Enhanced Brand Reputation: Winning an award is a powerful endorsement. It signals to potential clients, partners, and investors that a company is a leader in its field. This can lead to increased credibility and trust. Networking Opportunities: The awards ceremony itself is a prime networking event. Winners gain direct access to key decision-makers, industry peers, and potential collaborators. Attracting Top Talent: A company recognized for excellence becomes more appealing to prospective employees. Award wins can significantly aid recruitment efforts, helping firms attract the best talent. Media Coverage: Winners frequently enough receive media coverage in industry publications and mainstream media outlets. This increased exposure enhances brand visibility and further promotes their achievements. The “Commercial Transaction of the year” category specifically offers winners a chance to showcase their innovative deal-making skills. This can be notably beneficial as these deals are often complex and require creative solutions. Through winning this award, companies can set themselves apart from the competition and highlight their ability to navigate challenges.
Tips for Maximizing the Impact To fully leverage the benefits of an award, winners should proactively communicate their success. Here’s how:
Press release: Issue a press release promptly following the proclamation of the award win. Highlight the key achievements that led to the recognition. Social Media Campaign: Utilize social media platforms to share the good news.Post photos from the awards ceremony and engage with followers. Website Updates: Update the company website to showcase the award win. Display the award logo prominently and include a dedicated page about the achievement. Client Communications: Inform existing clients about the award win. Mention the achievement in newsletters and client meetings. Frequently Asked Questions Here are some common questions about the awards and their impact:
Q: How does winning an award influence investment decisions?
A: Award wins can increase investor confidence.They demonstrate a company’s market leadership, financial stability, and innovative approach, making them a more attractive investment.
Q: What are the long-term benefits of receiving the “Lifetime Property Excellence” award?
A: The “Lifetime Property Excellence” award positions recipients as industry icons, opening avenues for mentorship and thought leadership. It reinforces their legacy within the Irish property sector.
